id: title:Gilbert09:say to reconnect when a google account owns no property

review.posthog_relevance: Google Search Console credential validation, distinguishing account-level permission failure from property-specific visibility.
review.reason: The production hunk P1.F1.H1 adds a guard clause that returns False and a specific error message when no Search Console properties are found. This prevents users from receiving a generic 'not visible' error when the account lacks any property, distinguishing account-level permission failure from property-specific visibility. observations.behavior: Adds a guard clause returning False and a specific error message when no properties are found.
observations.posthog_connection: Checks if the Google account has any Search Console properties; if none exist, it immediately fails credential validation rather than proceeding to a generic 'not visible' error, distinguishing account-level permission failure from property-specific visibility. This prevents users from being sent back to re-check URL formatting when the account owns no property at all.
